classification.difficultyReason: Convert a bearing to an acute triangle angle and calculate an eastward distance.

content.prompt:
A speed boat travels 80 km on a bearing of $048^\circ$.
Find how far east of its starting point the speed boat is, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Compass rose at an unnamed starting point, northeast segment, origin dot and an unlabelled clockwise bearing arc. The far endpoint has no dot or name.
spec.mathematics: The segment lies on bearing 048 degrees; endpoint direction is (sin 48 degrees, cos 48 degrees).
spec.answerVisibility: No numerical angle, distance or answer is printed in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the eastward distance in kilometres. The angle between the boat's path and east is $90^\circ-48^\circ=42^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos42^\circ&=\frac{x}{80}\\x&=80\cos42^\circ\\x&\approx59.45\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
